run_train_controlnet: run the ControlNet training script with JAX/Flax for Stable Diffusion using argparse CLI
run_validation: run validation on the trained ControlNet model using the FlaxStableDiffusionControlNetPipeline
run_dataset_preprocessing: run dataset preprocessing to tokenize captions and transform images for ControlNet training
run_gradient_accumulation: run training with gradient accumulation steps using JAX pmap and optax optimizer
run_model_export: run the final model export and push trained ControlNet weights to Hugging Face Hub
